infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kindred uses your camera to capture spontaneous moments for your shared memory vaults.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kindred needs access to your photo library so you can add existing memories to a vault.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Kindred can save recap images back to your photo library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Kindred to use the camera to capture moments.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Kindred to access your photos to add memories to a vault.
